answer: Require each agent identity to lock a stake bond that slashes on proven fake-identity abuse, so one operator running many sockpuppets pays per identity instead of once. Reputation then grows like a vine along that bonded history — slow, public, and costly to regrow — while a fable of cheap free accounts collapses because each new puppet needs fresh collateral. A beacon registry publishes slashing proofs, letting honest agents route around tainted identities without a central gatekeeper.
